Typedefs

typedef T_APP_RESULT (*P_FUN_GATT_CLIENT_CB)(uint16_t conn_handle, T_GATT_CLIENT_EVENT type, void *p_data)

P_FUN_GATT_CLIENT_CB Specific Client Callback Function Point Definition.

Function pointer used in each specific client module, to send events to specific client module. The events please refer to T_GATT_CLIENT_EVENT.

typedef T_APP_RESULT (*P_FUN_GATT_STORAGE_CB)(T_GATT_STORAGE_EVENT type, void *p_data)

P_FUN_GATT_STORAGE_CB GATT Storage Callback Function Point Definition.

Function pointer used to handle GATT storage event T_GATT_STORAGE_EVENT.

struct T_GATT_STORAGE_SVC_TBL_GET_IND

Get stored services table indication data.

The event data for GATT_STORAGE_EVENT_SVC_TBL_GET_IND. After application calls gatt_client_start_discovery_all, Bluetooth GATT client will send GATT_STORAGE_EVENT_SVC_TBL_GET_IND first to check whether application has saved the service table.

Public Members

uint8_t addr[6]
uint8_t remote_bd_type
uint16_t data_len

Provided by application.

uint8_t *p_data

Provided by application.

struct T_GATT_STORAGE_SVC_TBL_USING_DATABASE_HASH_GET_IND

Get stored services table using database hash value indication data.

The event data for GATT_STORAGE_EVENT_SVC_TBL_USING_DATABASE_HASH_GET_IND. After application calls gatt_client_start_discovery_all, Bluetooth GATT client may send GATT_STORAGE_EVENT_SVC_TBL_USING_DATABASE_HASH_GET_IND to check whether application has saved the service table.

This event is used for Robust Caching, application can call gatt_client_cfg_client_supported_feature(GATT_SVC_CLIENT_SUPPORTED_FEATURES_ROBUST_CACHING_BIT) to open this function.

Public Members

uint8_t addr[6]
uint8_t remote_bd_type
uint8_t database_hash[16]
uint16_t data_len

Provided by application.

uint8_t *p_data

Provided by application.

struct T_GATT_STORAGE_SVC_TBL_SET_IND

Set stored services table indication data.

The event data for GATT_STORAGE_EVENT_SVC_TBL_SET_IND. If the services are actually discovered after the gatt_client_start_discovery_all is called, notify the application to store the service table.
